comment.body: 感谢提供诊断压缩包。日志中已经确认 SettingsSync 因 `untrusted-signature` 拒绝连接，这不是仅凭提示文字猜测的网络或密钥问题。相关调查见 #51567 和 #50795，候选修复为 #51789，目前仍未合并或发布。无需再次上传相同日志或重复已提供的操作；也不建议混用不同版本的可执行文件或绕过签名检查。

issue_context.analysis: Use the existing explicit investigation and candidate rather than create a competing fix or repeat reinstall/network checklists. Preserve the distinction between an inspected diagnostic signature and a behavior-only grouping. An open candidate and participant preview success are not released repairs.
known_information: The report supplies 0.102.3001, failure when creating a local key, a screenshot and a diagnostic ZIP.

Read all Settings and MouseWithoutBorders text logs in the supplied archive. Settings logs, including November 3, contain the exact failure: Couldn't create SettingsSync: System.UnauthorizedAccessException: Rejected SettingsSync server: untrusted-signature.
The inspected archive establishes local SettingsSync signer rejection; it does not establish a remote network or security-key mismatch.
Existing report #51567 and signer investigation #50795 cover this failure class. Candidate #51789 remains open and unmerged, not shipped.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report, empty discussion and timeline; retained the supplied installation, failed operation and any attachments.

Compared with the fully reassessed covering discussion and current candidate. For #51877 read the supplied Settings/MWB log entries without executing archive content; no archive was supplied for #51878.
inferences: The archive supports the signer-rejection class, not an independently measured leaf-certificate inventory or a universal diagnosis of all pairing failures.
issue_context.summary: Supplied archive proves local SettingsSync signer rejection; route to the existing MWB candidate.

fix_assessment.rationale: The existing pairing/key-generation investigation and its open signer-policy candidate cover this reported class; release and local-diagnosis qualifications remain explicit.
